reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need a to-go version. And it's capsules, two of them, and I only do gummies or drinks.
objection: Two capsules a night is a no for me, I hate swallowing pills, and I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles.
would_change_my_mind: If it came as a gummy or a drink mix instead of capsules, and I was actually traveling a lot.
